periods.time: Day after Bell and Welf's contract

name.zh: 贝尔、韦尔夫与莉莉首次第11层组队
name.en: Bell, Welf, and Lili's First 11th-Floor Party Run

periods.summary: Welf joins Bell and Lili on the 11th floor so he can seek the experience needed for the Forge development ability. Lili distrusts the arrangement at first, but the trio fights through a monster party, Bell tests his Lv.2 speed and magic, Welf defeats Orcs, and Bell saves Welf from a Silverback encirclement.
periods.cause: Welf is ostracized by Hephaestus Familia peers and cannot safely seek Forge experience alone; Bell also needs another party member before middle-floor progression.
periods.process: The party enters the 11th floor, Lili argues that Welf is temporary and risky, and monsters spawn around the chamber. Bell handles Imps and Hard Armoreds with his new Lv.2 power, while Welf takes Orcs with Lili's support. When Silverbacks surround Welf, Bell breaks the encirclement and coordinates a finish with him.
periods.outcome: The party survives the monster party, Welf acknowledges the value of teammates, and Bell confirms that his level-up dramatically improved his speed, cutting power, and Firebolt.
periods.aftermath: The group rests in the chamber and Bell begins thinking about how his new skill Heroic Desire might work.
periods.significance: This is the first functioning three-person version of Bell's party and proves Welf can fill the front-line role Ryu said Bell needed.
